title: Coast Guard Station Calumet Harbor Rescues Mariners, Dogs
description:
A Coast Guard Calumet Harbor Response Boat-medium crew transfers a mariner aboard from a sailboat beset by heavy weather near Wilmette, Illinois, Oct. 22, 2017.

The 37-foot de-masted sailboat was left at anchor with navigation lights energized approximately one nautical mile offshore.

U.S. Coast Guard video.
